sources: Installed ability 13403 Mountain Affinity; civilization help 120194

paragraphs: The Monaspa is the Georgians' unique cavalry unit. These armored horsemen are strongest when they fight together, gaining extra attack from nearby Monaspas and Knight-line units.

Georgian mounted units regenerate health, helping surviving riders recover between engagements. Their strength in close formations makes a mass of Monaspas a dangerous opponent, but it still has to close the distance against ranged enemies.
These equal-resource battles test the Elite Monaspa against the game's unique units, from infantry and cavalry to archers and siege weapons.
